alert.started: Trailhead: remote access has a problem
alert.still: Trailhead: remote access still has a problem
alert.clearedDetail: The problem Trailhead reported earlier has cleared.
alert.other: Something Trailhead checks isn't right. Open Trailhead's page for details.

alert.address.no_public_address: Trailhead can't find this connection's public address, so the name may point to an old one.
